blocks.text: Fully managed MongoDB with global distribution

MongoDB Atlas removes the operational burden of running MongoDB in production. Automated backups, scaling, monitoring, security patching, and upgrades are handled by the platform. Your team focuses on building features while Atlas keeps the database running reliably.

The multi-cloud flexibility is unique among managed database providers. Deploy on AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure - or distribute across multiple clouds for resilience. This flexibility avoids single-vendor lock-in at the infrastructure level.

Atlas Search brings Lucene-based full-text search directly into MongoDB. Instead of syncing data to a separate Elasticsearch cluster, define search indexes alongside your data and query with the same MongoDB driver. For applications needing search, this eliminates an entire infrastructure component.
Deploy on AWS, GCP, or Azure - or distribute across all three
Compute and storage scale based on workload demands
Full-text search with Lucene indexing built into MongoDB
Query data across Atlas, S3, and other sources
For teams committed to MongoDB, Atlas provides the best managed experience. The built-in search, multi-cloud deployment, and operational automation justify the cost over self-hosting.
Our engineers work with MongoDB Atlas daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
